_comment: Ways to begin the game. A track only says where the company starts (cash, which businesses exist, what the bank offers); the simulation does not know about tracks. existing_bakery is the game up to version 0.5 (its numbers stay in world.json under start). owner starts with an empty rented space: the player chooses a business and its size, and may borrow from the bank from day one. Provisional numbers until the balance run is approved.
